title: Schedule
description: profiles/<slug>/schedules/<id>.json: a recurring ticket template. Type Schedule in src/server/types.ts; written by Store.saveSchedule (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomic temp+rename) from src/server/scheduler.ts. New schedules always also have tags, quiet, model and partOf; they are not required here because older files lack them. Unknown fields must be kept.

id.description: 8 base36 chars (newId). Equals the file name without .json.

title.description: Ticket title; {date} and {time} are filled in when it fires.

cron.description: 5-field cron, whitespace collapsed to single spaces.

partOf.description: A main ticket's id or one of its groups'.
